title: RK ROYAL KLUDGE R104 Pro Wireless Mechanical Keyboard $75.25, M20 Numpad Keyboard $39.82 Delivered @ Royal Kludge
body:
Deal: RK ROYAL KLUDGE R104 Pro Wireless Mechanical Keyboard $75.25, M20 Numpad Keyboard $39.82 Delivered @ Royal Kludge

[NEWLAND] Update: The N99 keyboards have cleared customs in Australia and are currently being transported to our warehouse. Once delivered, we will ship all goods on the same day. We apologize for the delay; all customers who purchased the N99 keyboard will receive 5 AUD in store credits and a permanent 5% membership discount. Thank you for your patience.
[DjRewind] when are the next batch of N99 keyboards coming to the Australian warehouse for purchase? I have one and would like a 2nd. Great keyboard!
[NEWLAND] This batch is expected to be delivered and shipped within a week. After the pre-orders are sent out, the quantity of some colors may not be sufficient. We have already arranged for the next batch of goods to replenish them, and we hope that the latest batch can be delivered to the warehouse before Black Friday.
[scrimshaw] What is the M20 supposed to be priced at, did you have a discount for these? RKozr104p does not work for the keypad and your deal title was incomplete.
[NEWLAND] Sorry, it seems I didn't save the edit; it has been corrected.
[DiscountForThee] I've been really enjoying my full size, wired keyboard from them. Probably as good as it can get at this price range
[NEWLAND] Thank you for your support friend. I tried out our sample of this keyboard, and it's really great.
[frankyuan1991] Do you guys have plan to have some 98-108 keyboard with AA or AAA battery powered instead of Lithium Battery？
[NEWLAND] Hi friend. There are currently no using AAA battery plans; the use of rechargeable batteries is the current trend.
[gg99] are these clicky? i love them keyboards super clicky (and noisy). I literally want everyone in the office to know when i'm typing
[NEWLAND] Sorry friend. This keyboard doesn't come with Clicky switches by default because they're not widely used these days, so they're not included as a default option during production. You can check out our other products, such as the RK918 and RK61, which come with Clicky switches. You can also contact me via email : sales9@rkgaming.com or private message to purchase additional Clicky switch packs for a relatively inexpensive price.
[undadog] i really like the RK ROYAL KLUDGE L98 with the numpad on the left instead of the right. it just feels more natural having the mouse closer to the keyboard.
[NEWLAND] Hi friend. I create a code saving USD$12 for you if you need it: RKozrL98
[undadog] thank you but I already have one! i was just commenting that it was a very nice keyboard from me using it!
[bogak] Thanks for the bargain, been waiting for this.
